text:
Rosie: hi all, im Rosie, starting on runtime today. trying to build main on ubuntu 22.04 (corp laptop) with CUDA 11.8 and gcc 12. getting weird ptxas/arch errors during compile. anyone seen this flow for onboarding?
Rosie: error snippet:
```
ptxas fatal : ValueError: unsupported PTX version '8.7'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Samir: welcome! quick debug checklist: `nvcc --version`, `nvidia-smi`, `which ptxas`, `ptxas --version`
Rosie: nvcc 11.8.89, driver shows 520.61.05, `which ptxas` -> /usr/local/cuda-11.8/bin/ptxas, ptxas --version -> 10.6.0
Dan: hi Rosie, congrats on joining. this usually means driver < toolkit capability. on corp machines we often fallback by setting `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` to avoid generating PTX for newest archs
Mika: also try setting `CUDAHOSTCXX=/usr/bin/g++-11` if the build pulls a newer gcc by default. but the PTX version error is more driver/toolkit mismatch territory
Rosie: corp laptop prevents driver upgrade. can you paste a small env example for the arch fallback?
Samir: set env before build:
```
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="6.0;7.0;7.5"
make -j6 BUILD_USE_CUDA=1
```
That keeps nvcc from emitting PTX for latest compute capabilities
Rosie: tried that and it advanced past ptxas but now hitting `undefined reference to cublasLtCreate` at link stage
Dan: link issue is common. ensure `-lcublasLt` is in link flags and ordered before `-lcublas`/`-lcudart`. also verify `/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64/libcublasLt.so` exists
Rosie: libcublasLt present. patched Makefile to add `-lcublasLt -lcublas -lcudart` and it linked. build completed locally :)
Mika: awesome. please drop a short onboarding note in the eng-runtime wiki with steps: (1) check driver vs toolkit, (2) TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST fallback, (3) cublasLt link-order, and (4) prefer infra runtime-dev docker image if you can (image: registry.redwood/internal/runtime-dev:cuda11.8-gcc12-2026-02-15)
Rosie: will do. one more q: for reproducing CI failures, is the recommended flow to use the infra dev image or replicate exact driver versions?
Samir: infra image is easiest to reproduce build env; for runtime tests you need a matching driver on host. CI uses GPU runners with driver 525+ for 11.8 builds
infra-bot: Note: CI GPU runners: driver 525.85+, toolkit 11.8. See infra docs: /internal/runbooks/runtime-gpu-runners.md
Rosie: thanks all 44b. adding note now & pinging Mika for doc merge
Mika: welcome again! ping if you want pairing for first-week tasks
